items.title: CNG consumption tops 18 mcm/d as Iran’s fuel-management policies take effect
items.summary: TEHRAN- The CEO of the National Iranian Oil Refining and Distribution Company, Mohammad Sadegh Azimifar, said daily CNG consumption has risen to more than 18 million cubic meters, up from about 14.5 million before new policies—an average increase of 16–17 percent, or over 3.5 million cubic meters per day.

ai.sum: Iran's CNG consumption rose above 18 million cubic meters per day after new fuel-management policies took effect.

items.title: Iran’s 3 chambers propose export-import mechanism to resolve economic woes
items.summary: TEHRAN- The monthly meeting of the heads of the Iran Chamber of Commerce, Industries, Mines and Agriculture; the Iran Chamber of Guilds; and the Iran Chamber of Cooperatives was held, focusing on the private sector’s concentration on solutions to support the government in supplying essential goods.

ai.sum: Iran's three chambers of commerce proposed an export-import mechanism to address economic problems and support supply of essential goods.

items.title: Sangan: A Hidden Gem Where History Meets Nature
items.summary: Just 30 kilometers northwest of Tehran, the historic village of Sangan offers a blend of centuries-old traditions, cultural heritage and breathtaking mountain scenery, making it an ideal rural tourism destination.

items.title: Iran’s army chief vows ‘more crushing’ response if US attacks again
items.summary: Army commander-in-chief Amir Hatami said Iranian forces would strike the US “along with its supporters” wherever they were based, as CENTCOM confirmed the USS Theodore Roosevelt had joined two other carriers in the region.

items.title: Hezbollah chief offers condolences on passing of Ayatollah Vahid Khorasani
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA - The Secretary-General of Lebanon's Hezbollah, while offering condolences on the passing of Ayatollah Vahid Khorasani, emphasized that throughout his life he firmly defended the path of truth.

ai.sum: Hezbollah's secretary-general offered condolences on the death of Ayatollah Vahid Khorasani.

items.title: Killing of Iranian schoolgirl sparks calls for legal reform
items.summary: The killing of a 16-year-old Iranian girl, allegedly by her father, has prompted lawyers and women's rights activists to demand tougher penalties for child killings and greater accountability from schools and child protection agencies in the western city of Kermanshah.

items.title: Iran shoots down another US MQ-9 drone over Strait of Hormuz
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s Army Air Defense Force has announced the interception and destruction of one more US MQ-9 drone, in the skies over east of the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: COP31: Iran Calls for Global Recognition of War-Driven Ecocide
items.summary: As world leaders gather at COP31 to discuss the future of the planet, Iran is drawing attention to a glaring contradiction: while nations pledge to fight climate change, the environmental devastation caused by wars in Iran, Gaza and Lebanon remains largely absent from the global climate agenda.

ai.sum: Iran is calling at COP31 for global recognition of environmental damage caused by wars in Iran, Gaza and Lebanon.

items.summary: Bahrain has arrested dozens of Shia clerics since the Iran war began in late February. Authorities accuse them of plotting with Tehran, while rights groups have raised concerns about torture and forced confessions. Gulf states have backed Bahrain’s judiciary.

items.title: Iran’s deterrence strategy adapts to evolving threats: Defense Ministry
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA – Defense Ministry spokesperson Brigadier General Reza Talaei-Nik says Iran’s deterrence strategy remains dynamic and active in response to the changing nature and patterns of warfare, noting that recent hybrid warfare differs significantly from previous conflicts.

ai.sum: Iran's Defence Ministry says its deterrence strategy is adapting to hybrid warfare, which differs significantly from previous conflicts.

items.title: Iran defined over 70 defense projects in Ramadan War, says deputy minister
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA — The deputy defense minister says that his ministry defined more than 70 projects across various fields during the third imposed war, focusing on translating battlefield developments and requirements into technology and operational capability.

ai.sum: Iran's deputy defence minister says the ministry defined over 70 projects during the so-called Ramadan War, aimed at turning battlefield lessons into technology and capability.

items.title: Abdanan protests draw solidarity and fears of renewed crackdown
items.summary: Protests following a deadly bus crash in Iran's western city of Abdanan have drawn messages of solidarity from Iranians across the country, with many praising demonstrators' defiance and expressing fears of renewed repression.

items.summary: Tehran, IRNA — Iran is standing firm against mounting pressure from its enemies and will not allow them to achieve their objectives, the commander of Iran’s Border Guard Command says.

items.title: Gulf countries under fire after US hits Iran island
items.summary: Gulf nations scrambled to intercept incoming fire from Iran and its allies on Wednesday after the US struck an Iranian island, as rising violence threatened efforts to resolve the Middle East war. Kuwait activated its air defences to counter drone strikes -- the first since early September -- and Bahrain said it fended off an Iranian attack, after the United States struck Iran's Qeshm Island in the flashpoint Strait of Hormuz.

ai.sum: Gulf states intercepted incoming fire from Iran and allies after the US struck Qeshm Island; Kuwait activated air defences and Bahrain fended off an attack.

items.title: Araghchi dismisses CNN, NYT reports as ‘rubbish’
items.summary: Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has dismissed recent reports by CNN and The New York Times alleging Iranian plans to use chemical weapons in Washington and build missile bases beneath dams, describing them as “rubbish.”

ai.sum: Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi dismissed CNN and NYT reports on Iranian chemical weapons plans and missile bases under dams as 'rubbish'.

items.title: Protest over 13 worker deaths turns against Islamic Republic
items.summary: Protests over the deaths of 13 oil and gas workers in a bus crash escalated into anti-establishment demonstrations, with security forces firing shots and tear gas and arresting protesters in western Iran on Tuesday.

items.title: Army chief warns of stronger response to any renewed aggression against Iran
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s Army Chief Major General Amir Hatami has warned that any renewed enemy attack would be met with a more forceful response without geographical restrictions.

ai.sum: Iran's army chief warned that any renewed attack on Iran would meet a stronger response without geographical limits.
